thread:
Maya: Quick async sync — cutting an internal checkpoint for the Helix private rollout. Milestone: last-mile network + customer smoke by EOD Thu. Two open items I need owners on: 1) egress cert rotation for customer NAT, 2) airgap image signing validation. @Alejandra can you confirm egress cert owner? pinging @Samir for oncall/fallback plan. Reply with short status (ok / blocked / ETA).

Alejandra: I can own the egress cert rotation. Need a netops ticket and read access to the customer KMS ARN. ETA Wed EOD assuming customer provides ARN. Blocking: no KMS ARN yet.

Ryan: CS update — asked the customer for KMS ARN + ACLs yesterday, they said "working with security team" and expect to send by tomorrow noon. I'll chase and post when I have it.

Samir: Oncall POV — we should have a fallback route and a temporary NAT pair ready. I can draft an Ops playbook (failover steps + quick rollback). ETA: tomorrow 09:30. Also flagging metrics to watch: `nat_conn_errors`, `egress_5xx_rate`, `kv_cache_miss_ratio`.

InfraBot: Checklist snapshot:
- network ACLs verified: NO
- KMS ARN received: NO
- image-signer key available: NO
- PRs blocking infra: 1 (net-provision #412)

Maya: Thanks. @Alejandra can you also take a quick look at net-provision PR #412? small templating change to egress cidr. If you can review today we might avoid the Thu afternoon rush.

Alejandra: On it, I skimmed earlier — looks safe. Will do final pass after stand.

Maya: Airgap signing — @Lee volunteered in the kickoff. Lee, can you confirm whether the image signing script supports customer-provided GPG keys, or do we need to generate via our HSM? If we need HSM, we'll need customer approval for key escrow.

Lee: I can own the airgap signing integration. Quick status: the script supports both workflows but the customer-provided key path requires `gpg --import` into our staging runner image and an annotation step in the manifest. If they won't provide keys we can generate and wrap via HSM, but that adds paperwork (privacy + escrow approval). ETA: Thurs AM to validate with staging.

Maya: Perfect. Action items captured:
- Alejandra -> egress cert rotation + review PR #412 (ETA Wed EOD)
- Ryan -> chase KMS ARN + ACLs from customer (ETA tomorrow noon)
- Samir -> failover playbook + metrics watch (ETA tomorrow 09:30)
- Lee -> validate image signing paths in staging (ETA Thu AM)

If any item becomes blocked, mark `blocked:` and short reason. I'll reconvene in this thread at 13:00 PT tomorrow to close the loop. :thumbsup:

Alejandra: blocked: waiting on customer KMS ARN (will update when I get it).

Ryan: noted, pinging customer now.

Samir: will post a short playbook + `curl` smoke command for NAT validation in this thread once done. Example I'll include:
```
# quick NAT egress check
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://httpstat.us/200
```

Maya: thanks all. If PR #412 merges and we get the KMS ARN, we should be green for the EOD Thu smoke. Otherwise prep for a narrow rollback window.

InfraBot: Reminder: deploy freeze window between Thu 17:00-20:00 UTC for customer cutover. Plan merges before freeze or schedule post-freeze.

Ryan: Customer confirmed they will try to deliver ARN by 11:30 PT. I'll update immediately.

Maya: closing loop for now — will follow up 13:00 PT tomorrow. Leave short status updates here. :coffee:
